cases.name: binding_transitions
assertions: active may transition to suspended or revoked
suspended may transition to active or revoked
revoked is terminal
competing commands from the same relevant revision have at most one committed outcome

cases.name: session_transitions
assertions: request authorize notice close is accepted
request or authorize may close an aborted session
authorize without request and notice without authorize are rejected
close is terminal

cases.name: release_recipient_binding
assertions: release recipient actor and key exactly match authorization
the recipient key resolves to the authorized audit actor
actor or key substitution fails with audit_release_manifest_invalid

cases.name: release_window
assertions: release cannot precede first_auditable_epoch
sealed epoch release cannot include the current active epoch
sealed epoch release requires sealed_by_commit_ref
target release must be inside the encryption-time eligibility snapshot

cases.name: binding_and_authorization_gate
assertions: release requires an active binding
suspended and revoked bindings fail closed
expired authorization fails closed
release requires the accepted session head to be notice

cases.name: close_release_concurrency
assertions: confirmed close rejects later release; prior release stales a close authored against the previous release log revision
a release accepted in an earlier Seal must appear in close release_refs
release after close is rejected
release order is confirmed Seal sequence then command_results position

cases.name: ryw_before_output
assertions: wrapped material is not output before release acceptance
attested_hardware requires a valid independent-witness RYW receipt
receipt policy digest and release eligibility proof agree
output occurs at most once after all gates pass
